2608.11822.title: Located but Not Releasable: Silent Gate Inversion and Bounded Linear Release
2608.11822.paper_summary: A growing body of work reports that language models represent task-relevant latent structure that they fail to use. Whether such structure, once located, can be converted into behavior is a separate question that is rarely tested end to end. We submit the complete pipeline -- detect, localize, and release -- to a fully preregistered stress test on a 25.7M transformer trained on causal-evidence discrimination, where a known suppression phenomenon (latent causal structure present but behaviorally unused) has previously been documented. Every threshold, claim template, and decision-tree branch was hashed and archived before any corresponding data existed. Three findings. (i) Localization succeeds: interventions at observation-evidence channels of mid layers restore target behavior on otherwise-suppressed worlds (paired release advantages $0.563$ and $0.854$, 97.5% CIs excluding zero; best-site release rate $0.889$). (ii) Gating fails out of distribution: a detector calibrated to trigger on zero out-of-distribution calibration worlds triggers on 6.9-7.3% of held-out in-distribution generations and on zero of the 2,400 held-out generations that actually need it -- a complete inversion that silently reduces the gated pipeline to its base model. (iii) Linear release is capped: removing the gate and injecting a per-instance linear direction unconditionally yields a monotone dose-response that plateaus far below the preregistered release margin (intercept $0.382 \to 0.311 \to 0.264$ vs. threshold $\le 0.08$); per-instance adaptivity adds less than $\pm 0.03$. The failure is doubly located: the detector is OOD-inverted, and the entire family of linear release directions at this site and resolution is bounded away from sufficiency. The two failures are dissociable, and neither overturns localization. Every number traces to a hashed artifact in the released audit chain.
2608.11822.paper_summary_zh: 越來越多的研究報告指出，語言模型代表了與任務相關的潛在結構，但它們未能利用這些結構。這種結構一旦被定位，是否可以轉化為行為是一個單獨的問題，這個問題很少進行全面測試。我們提交了完整的流程——檢測、定位和釋放——對一個在因果證據辨識上訓練的 25.7M Transformer進行完全預註冊的壓力測試，之前已記錄到一種已知的抑制現象（潛在因果結構存在但行為上未被使用）。每個閾值、聲明模板和決策樹分支在任何相應數據存在之前都已被哈希並存檔。三個發現。(i) 定位成功：在中層的觀察證據通道進行干預可以恢復在其他被抑制的世界中的目標行為（配對釋放優勢 $0.563$ 和 $0.854$，97.5% 的置信區間不包括零；最佳站點釋放率 $0.889$）。(ii) 閘控在分佈外失敗：一個經過校準以在零分佈外校準世界上觸發的檢測器在 6.9-7.3% 的保留內部生成中觸發，而在實際需要它的 2,400 個保留生成中則沒有觸發——這是一個完全的顛倒，默默地將閘控流程減少到其基本模型。(iii) 線性釋放受到限制：去除閘控並無條件地注入每個實例的線性方向，產生一個單調的劑量反應，該反應在預註冊的釋放邊際之下平穩（截距 $0.382 \to 0.311 \to 0.264$ 對比閾值 $\le 0.08$）；每個實例的適應性增加少於 $\pm 0.03$。這一失敗雙重定位：檢測器是 OOD 反轉的，並且在此站點和解析度下，整個線性釋放方向的家族被限制在不足夠的範圍之外。這兩個失敗是可分離的，且都不推翻定位。每個數字都追溯到釋放審計鏈中的一個哈希文物。
